title: 軌枕耐久與承載試驗
summary: 軌枕耐久與承載試驗以「軌枕彎曲預力疲勞與環境耐久」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。軌枕把扣件荷載分散至道碴或支承面，軌座與中部彎矩取決於接觸分布；承載試驗和耐久試驗需要分別定義邊界與損傷指標。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。
summaryEn: This course develops sleeper bending prestress fatigue and environmental durability through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Sleepers distribute fastening loads to ballast or support surfaces; rail-seat and centre moments depend on contact distribution, so load tests and durability tests need separate boundaries and damage indicators. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.textEn: This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: P=60 kN, L=1.6 m; y=P*L/4=24 kN*m. Increasing only P with a ten-percent increase gives y=26.4 kN*m. Boundary: One central point load, ideal simple supports and quasistatic response; actual ballast support distribution is not represented; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. stages.title: 簡支跨中彎矩與軌枕彎曲應力

stages.description: 本階段聚焦「簡支跨中彎矩」與「軌枕彎曲應力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。

steps.title: 簡支跨中彎矩：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Simply supported midspan moment: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「簡支跨中彎矩」如何影響軌枕耐久與承載試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Simply supported midspan moment” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sleeper durability and load testing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 跨中集中載重的彎矩取決於支點間距。本模型把 P 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 26.4 kN*m。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。單一跨中集中力、理想簡支及準靜態；不是實際道碴支承分布。使用荷載與支承距離作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；試驗支點不同會使結果不可直接比較，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「簡支跨中彎矩」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Moment under a central load depends on support spacing. In this model, P is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 26.4 kN*m. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. One central point load, ideal simple supports and quasistatic response; actual ballast support distribution is not represented. Use load and support spacing as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Different test support positions prevent direct comparison; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Simply supported midspan moment” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 簡支跨中彎矩：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Simply supported midspan moment: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「簡支跨中彎矩」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：P=60 kN, L=1.6 m；y=P*L/4=24 kN*m。只把 P 增加百分之十，y=26.4 kN*m。模型邊界：單一跨中集中力、理想簡支及準靜態；不是實際道碴支承分布；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

Increasing only P with a ten-percent increase gives y=26.4 kN*m. Boundary: One central point load, ideal simple supports and quasistatic response; actual ballast support distribution is not represented; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use load and support spacing to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.titleEn: Simply supported midspan moment: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「簡支跨中彎矩」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Simply supported midspan moment” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以荷載與支承距離區分模型與觀察，先用縮尺梁支點位置、荷重元及跨中應變建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「簡支跨中彎矩」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use load and support spacing to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Simply supported midspan moment. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Different test support positions prevent direct comparison. steps.failure: 注意干擾：試驗支點不同會使結果不可直接比較。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.instruction: 平均預壓可抵消部分拉應力，但偏心也帶入彎矩。本模型把 P 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 6.6 MPa。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。預力為損失後的有效值且壓力均布；偏心彎矩另列。使用預力值與端部應變作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；忽略預力損失會高估抗裂能力，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「預力平均壓應力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.instruction: 忽略預力損失會高估抗裂能力。這個失效與「預力平均壓應力」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查預力值與端部應變，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring prestress loss overestimates crack resistance. This failure and a measurement bias in Mean prestress compression can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check prestress and end-region strain rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用預力值與端部應變作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；忽略預力損失會高估抗裂能力，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Ignoring prestress loss overestimates crack resistance; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：忽略預力損失會高估抗裂能力」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Ignoring prestress loss overestimates crack resistance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.instruction: 簡支梁撓度對跨度呈三次方依賴。本模型把 P 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 1.87733 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。均勻簡支梁受跨中力、微小撓度且忽略剪切變形。使用載重位移與支點沉陷作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；支點下陷會被誤算成試件撓度，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「彈性撓度檢核」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
